summary: Kimi Antonelli surged through to victory at Barcelona after a perfectly-timed virtual safety car disrupted Lando Norris's commanding lead, with the McLaren driver left to rue the "insanely unlucky" timing that cost him what appeared a certain win. Norris watched his pole position advantage evaporate in the closing stages, unable to recover as Mercedes capitalized on the safety car restart. The result marks Antonelli's breakthrough F1 win and tightens the championship fight, with McLaren's advantage over Mercedes now significantly reduced.
